status_legend.confirmed: Supported by inspected source, manifests, documentation, or upstream advisory data.
status_legend.test_evidence: Historical isolated test evidence; not production proof.
status_legend.unverified: Required runtime, browser, operator, or complete-scope evidence was not collected.
status_legend.inferred_risk: Potential impact of a confirmed condition, not an observed incident.

limitations.title: CRE workflow is not end-to-end wired
evidence: ultron/application/content/status.py:63-108 reports processing not configured, rendering preview-only, publishing mock-only, and analytics unavailable.
ultron/application/runtime/interface_gateway.py:828-836,4842-4854 exposes status and selected preview/review paths; CRE runtime setup is conditional.
limitations.impact: Local service classes must not be represented as an operator-usable end-to-end content pipeline.
limitations.recommended_action: Keep unavailable stages explicit; define authorized owner-scoped workflow and lifecycle before exposing intake-to-render operations.
limitations.acceptance: An isolated integration test demonstrates registered-byte hash, current-rights decision, transcript, candidate, render, review, cancellation/recovery, owner scope, and audit evidence at each boundary.
limitations.operator_dependency: Operator-approved CRE capability scope and legal rights policy.

limitations.title: CRE source reference is not discovery or legal clearance
evidence: ultron/application/content/service.py:185-370 hashes supplied bytes and records references; no source fetch/discovery path was identified.
ultron/application/content/service.py:371-682,1003-1162,1728-2040 implements rights/grant/evidence lifecycle checks but cannot independently establish ownership.
limitations.impact: An unverified URL or hash cannot authorize media processing or establish legal rights.
limitations.recommended_action: Require traceable acquisition and current, use-specific rights evidence before processing.
limitations.acceptance: Tests prove unverified references cannot authorize processing and that expiry/revocation blocks later actions.
limitations.operator_dependency: Rights policy and traceable source-acquisition procedure.

limitations.title: Production publishing is unavailable
evidence: ultron/application/content/publishing.py:54-78 is a mock adapter boundary.
docs/CONTENT_PUBLISHING_DESIGN.md:3-77,741-769 documents the absence of production transport, OAuth/session storage, and remote recovery.
limitations.impact: A mock acknowledgment is not external publication; no live platform state or revenue may be inferred.
limitations.recommended_action: Keep publishing disabled until protected credential storage, identity, rights/approval/kill-switch checks, durable state, and recovery are independently reviewed.
limitations.acceptance: Fake-transport tests prove fail-closed behavior and resumable recovery; any later live sandbox test requires separate explicit authorization.
limitations.operator_dependency: Platform credentials, legal rights approval, and explicit publication authorization.

limitations.title: CRE analytics and revenue evidence are absent
evidence: ultron/application/content/status.py:100-107 reports analytics.available=false.
docs/CONTENT_PUBLISHING_DESIGN.md:1098-1100 does not establish audience, monetization, or revenue evidence.
limitations.impact: Dashboard job/status counts are not platform analytics, monetization eligibility, or revenue.
limitations.recommended_action: Continue to show unavailable until authorized, source-attributed metrics with periods and freshness exist.
limitations.acceptance: Contract tests reject missing, stale, unsupported, or unauthenticated metrics and prevent revenue claims from upload/rights state.

limitations.title: Authenticated browser workflow and owner isolation are not verified
evidence: Source path exists through ultron/application/runtime/local_auth_helper.py, ultron/application/runtime/interface_gateway.py, interface/services/providers/websocketProvider.js, and interface/operator-console.js.
Prior operator did not complete the normal private dashboard unlock; no authenticated browser session or authorized second principal was used.
limitations.impact: Automated contracts do not prove current browser-to-live-service data flow, stale-state handling, rendered evidence, or cross-owner isolation.
limitations.recommended_action: Perform browser acceptance only through normal private unlock and authorized test principals; do not request or log credentials.
limitations.acceptance: Verify session expiry/revocation, helper reconnect, fresh CRE/System Intelligence status, stale/error state, all scene images decode, and owner isolation with authorized principals.
limitations.operator_dependency: Operator privately unlocks dashboard and supplies an authorized second principal if owner isolation is to be claimed.

limitations.title: Live manager ownership and loaded source identity remain ambiguous
evidence: Prior read-only runtime evidence recorded manager PID 6943 parenting four services while expected lease and control socket were absent; cause was not established.
scripts/ultron_service_manager.py validates process identity and does not provide an evidenced arbitrary adoption/handoff protocol.
Current manager/service state and source revision loaded by the process were not re-probed for this audit.
limitations.impact: A PID, port, or missing lease cannot prove ownership transfer or authorize starting a competing manager, signaling, restart, or deployment.
limitations.recommended_action: Keep live services untouched; have the operator authorize a read-only ownership-resolution and maintenance plan using process-start identity, parentage, executable/command identity, and manager records.
limitations.acceptance: Independent evidence establishes authoritative owner and safe recovery without adoption or signal before a separately approved maintenance window.
limitations.operator_dependency: Explicit operator authorization for any future live maintenance; this audit grants none.

limitations.title: No complete deployable release or known-good rollback is established
evidence: Workspace has no Git metadata, so a source commit/revision and mission ownership cannot be established.
docs/ULTRON_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json is explicitly preliminary/scoped and not a complete approved release allowlist.
Prior pre-change archive is evidence preservation only; no verified known-good rollback bundle is established.
limitations.impact: There is no defensible way to associate inspected/tested source with a deployable bundle or rollback target.
limitations.recommended_action: Obtain an owner-approved complete source/runtime allowlist; exclude secrets, DB/WAL/SHM, caches, virtual environments, and unrelated generated files; create and verify a reproducible bundle and restoration.
limitations.acceptance: Bundle member allowlist, SHA-256 manifest, dependency lock, archive integrity, isolated restoration, and post-restore manifest verification all pass.
limitations.operator_dependency: Release owner identifies intended release scope and approves required runtime assets.

limitations.title: Production database backup and recovery are not verified
evidence: scripts/ultron_sqlite_backup.py uses SQLite online backup and has isolated rehearsal evidence from prior missions.
No live CRE, operations, or conversation database was opened, copied, backed up, checkpointed, or restored in this audit.
limitations.impact: An isolated backup rehearsal does not prove a current protected production backup or a usable production restore point.
limitations.recommended_action: Before any authorized deployment, perform an approved online backup to an owner-only destination; preserve source DB/WAL/SHM and record integrity/schema/size/hash/timestamps without secrets.
limitations.acceptance: Restore a copy to a separate destination, verify integrity/schema/version and checksum, and record backup outcome.
limitations.operator_dependency: Explicit authorization, protected storage destination, expected schema/version, and maintenance owner.

limitations.title: OMEGA adapter destination is configurable while documentation claims loopback-only
evidence: ultron/application/runtime/interface_gateway.py:65-69,431-442 reads OMEGA_INTEGRATION_URL and attaches OMEGA_INTEGRATION_TOKEN to adapter requests.
docs/OPERATOR_CONSOLE.md:24 describes loopback-only polling, but the inspected adapter does not enforce loopback destination.
limitations.impact: A misconfigured URL could send an integration credential to an unintended destination.
limitations.recommended_action: Validate allowed scheme and destination before constructing any token-bearing request; reconcile the operator documentation. Do not inspect or modify OMEGA.
limitations.acceptance: Tests reject non-allowlisted hosts/schemes before transport and prove no credential header is sent on rejection.
limitations.operator_dependency: Approved destination allowlist and token-handling policy.

limitations.title: Voice synthesis route has broad CORS and no inspected handler authentication
evidence: ultron/voice/server.py:59-89 sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
ultron/voice/server.py:248-305 binds loopback and the inspected speak route has no authentication; manager config selects the Edge engine.
limitations.impact: Local/cross-origin invocation and unbounded resource use require explicit threat, rate, and cost review; no exploitation was observed.
limitations.recommended_action: Review allowed origins, request limits, concurrency/rate controls, and local-call assumptions without weakening loopback binding.
limitations.acceptance: Tests reject disallowed origins and oversized/over-rate requests while preserving loopback-only listener behavior.
limitations.operator_dependency: Voice engine/model and local UI origin requirements.

limitations.title: Trading source safeguards do not establish production account/order state
evidence: ultron/financial/bootstrap.py constructs PaperBroker/PaperTradingEngine; container paths require simulation mode and provider-backed order methods fail closed per existing documentation/tests.
The separate Streamlit dashboard can read paper-account snapshots; no order or live account was accessed.
limitations.impact: Paper-mode construction and UI telemetry are not proof of a production account's state or every reachable order boundary.
limitations.recommended_action: Keep all live paths blocked; verify isolated simulation and broker-boundary tests for every reachable entrypoint before any separately authorized change.
limitations.acceptance: Tests prove default paths use simulation and reject live submit/cancel; no live order is needed for this acceptance.
limitations.operator_dependency: Keep provider/account configuration separate from execution-mode approval.

limitations.title: Dependency licensing, advisory applicability, and version lock are unresolved
evidence: requirements.txt directly and unpinnedly declares PyMuPDF; current selected environment reports PyMuPDF 1.28.2 and source uses it in three PDF paths.
Official PyMuPDF documentation offers AGPL and commercial licensing; organizational approval is unknown.
Selected environment reports pypdf 6.20.0; OSV-backed scan reports three high advisories, listed fixed version 6.21.2.

Nested XTTS reference lock pins transformers 4.57.6. OSV GHSA-29pf-2h5f-8g72 says versions before 5.3.0 are affected; GHSA-fgcw-684q-jj6r metadata conflicts between its 5.2.0 description and broader affected range. Reachable model-loading paths in staging are unverified.
limitations.impact: Legal approval and actual production SBOM/advisory status cannot be closed; scanner records are not an approved deployed-package inventory.
limitations.recommended_action: Resolve PyMuPDF terms with counsel, produce a supported-runtime SBOM/lock, reconcile advisories and inspect nested model-loader callers before clearing Transformers; assess pypdf mitigation in a separate tested dependency change.
limitations.acceptance: Approved license disposition, exact artifact versions, advisory-range reconciliation, loader reachability review, and relevant compatibility/security tests are recorded.
limitations.operator_dependency: Legal/compliance decision and release owner-approved runtime scope.

limitations.title: Registered agents are not proven to participate in request routing
evidence: ultron/infrastructure/container.py registers agents and one ProviderManager/OllamaProvider.
docs/ULTRON_AGENT_CAPABILITY_AUDIT.md reports chat does not call AgentOrchestrator.dispatch and workflow execution has no runtime caller.
limitations.impact: Registry presence is not operational orchestration; selected model/provider health and fallback are not exposed.
limitations.recommended_action: Keep unsupported dispatch blocked; add provider readiness/failure telemetry and only integrate agent routes under the trusted authorization contract.
limitations.acceptance: Request-path tests demonstrate selected provider/agent, outage behavior, and no unauthorized dispatch.
limitations.operator_dependency: Local Ollama/model availability and model-version maintenance.

limitations.title: Conversation and memory lifecycle lacks consistent privacy controls
evidence: ultron/conversation/history/store.py persists message content without explicit permission hardening in the inspected store.
Conversation history has no documented export, deletion, or retention API; MemoryManager, semantic SQLite storage, and ExperienceStore use separate lifecycle semantics.
ExperienceStore.load() can return an empty list on read/JSON errors.
limitations.impact: Retention, deletion, derived-store invalidation, file privacy, and recovery semantics are inconsistent; empty-on-error can mask corrupted experience data.
limitations.recommended_action: Define storage permissions, retention, export/deletion, provenance/correction, and explicit corruption reporting across stores.
limitations.acceptance: Permission tests under permissive umask, deletion/retention tests, and corruption/recovery tests cover isolated stores.

limitations.title: System Intelligence collection has a persistence side effect
evidence: ultron/application/runtime/system_intelligence.py:280-390 collects host/process/service evidence and persists bounded diagnostics.
ultron/application/runtime/system_intelligence.py:498-535 requests a manager-owned helper restart over the local control socket.
limitations.impact: Collection must not be described as strictly read-only; retention and diagnostic-store permissions matter. Restart remains constrained to the manager-owned control path.
limitations.recommended_action: Document persisted diagnostic fields/retention and assert no signal outside validated manager ownership.
limitations.acceptance: Tests verify diagnostic permissions/retention and that a rejected/stale process identity cannot cause a service signal.

limitations.title: Operational documentation conflicts with current source
evidence: README.txt:3-8 still instructs applying a patch script.
docs/OPERATOR_CONSOLE.md:24 claims loopback-only OMEGA polling while source uses a configurable destination.
docs/ULTRON_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md contains historical test totals which must not be presented as current production verification.
limitations.impact: Operators may follow obsolete instructions or infer stronger runtime guarantees than source supports.
limitations.recommended_action: Reconcile source-facing setup/endpoint guidance and mark all dated test/runtime observations as historical or unverified.
limitations.acceptance: Documentation contract checks agree with source; setup and recovery instructions are reviewed by the responsible operator.

limitations.title: Static diagnostics do not provide full-project type validation
evidence: Pylance workspace settings report typeCheckingMode=off and diagnosticMode=openFilesOnly.
Import scan reports unresolved ultron_service_manager, imageio_ffmpeg, TTS, hydra, omegaconf, f5_tts, and librosa; runtime/optional staging applicability was not resolved.
limitations.impact: No full-project Pylance/type-check or complete runtime import audit can be claimed from the current editor configuration.
limitations.recommended_action: For a future release, run the repository's supported full static/import checks in the approved environment and classify optional/reference-only imports separately.
limitations.acceptance: A reproducible static/import validation is tied to the exact release dependency lock and has no unexplained runtime import failures.

limitations.title: Centrality, complexity, and import-cycle signals need targeted review
evidence: Cached project analysis reports two import cycles and high-complexity CRE, contract, operation-recovery, and System Intelligence functions.
Container import fan-out is high; no specific runtime defect was established from these metrics.
limitations.impact: Changes to central contracts and high-complexity lifecycle code have elevated regression risk.
limitations.recommended_action: Prioritize boundaries with regression tests and consider narrowly scoped decomposition only when a demonstrated defect or maintainability need exists.
limitations.acceptance: Review cycles and complexity findings against actual supported import/runtime paths; no broad refactor is justified by metrics alone.

limitations.title: Backup and reference files have uncertain dynamic or recovery use
evidence: docs/ULTRON_CLEANUP_RECORD.json records no deleted files and retains .backups/, .ultron_patch_backups/, ultron/voice/reference_staging/, and backup-named source copies.
No Git history or exhaustive external/plugin/import-loader proof is available.
limitations.impact: Apparent redundancy cannot safely be treated as dead code; including such material in a release could also add unrelated or sensitive artifacts.
limitations.recommended_action: Retain in the workspace; exclude from a release only through an approved allowlist. Delete only after proving callers, dynamic loading, operator recovery, and external use are absent.
limitations.acceptance: Every future removal has per-file purpose/reference/configuration/test/migration evidence and a recorded reason.

current_audit_tests.reason: The audit was static and read-only; delegated auditors did not run tests.

retained_uncertain_paths: backup-named and historical source copies listed in docs/ULTRON_CLEANUP_RECORD.json
